Description: Single demand-scenario label used in sector growth/share lookups (formerly the ``{demand}`` wildcard). Must be one value, not a list; use separate configs or ``run.name`` to compare scenarios.
UNSD data source. Legacy uses archived UNdata exports; SDMX uses the official UNSD SDMX API. Default is legacy.
Maximum lookback in years for missing base-year observations (SDMX only). Default is 0, requiring exact-year observations. Future observations are never used.
Refresh UNSD data when retrieval runs. If false, reuse existing cached data.
Base year for energy balances data. Default is 2019. Check data availability for the selected countries and year.
Determines whether to include unspecified industries. Note that some countries may have inflated numbers; review cautiously.
Year of the aluminium production data specified in ``data/AL_production.csv``. Default year is 2019.
